whyItMatters: os.system() hands a string to the system shell. Any attacker-influenced fragment becomes OS command injection with the application's privileges.
actions: Replace os.system() with subprocess.run([...]) using an argument list and shell=False.
Resolve the executable by absolute path and never concatenate input into a command string.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-010 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no os.system( call remains in the changed files.
